hackathon.eyebrow: META GLOBAL AI DEVELOPER HACKATHON · BUILD LOG
hackathon.title: Building, one real step at a time.
hackathon.intro: AdMorph AI is built in the open during the 26 October–4 November 2026 hackathon window. This page records what works today and what comes next.
hackathon.status: Meta-only · all three models run live
hackathon.statement: The first working baseline was prepared on 26 October 2026 and the Meta-only expansion was integrated on 27 October. Since then the work has moved in small reviewed pull requests (more than 200 commits so far), each with its test results, and the live site is re-tested with real Meta calls after each release.
hackathon.milestoneNote: The Day 1, Day 2 and Day 3 labels in earlier build-log entries are feature milestones, not separate calendar days. Anything listed as planned is not built yet.
completed: One-shot studio in five steps: a phone photo is cut out by SAM 3.1 (guided by a box from Muse Spark), the brand is read, three ideas are written in the chosen dialect, the ad is arranged at 4:5, 1:1 or 9:16, Muse Image paints it, and Muse Spark reviews it. A weak ad is repaired once automatically and ends with a fidelity certificate.
Shelf to campaign: one photo or short video of a shelf becomes one finished ad per product. Muse Spark finds up to six products and their price tags, and SAM 3.1 cuts each one out.
Seasonal copies and variants: a saved ad is redesigned for Ramadan, Eid, Black Friday or summer, or in new angles. The product, the logo and the icons stay as they were, in the same places.
Six copy dialects (Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, Sudanese, Modern Standard Arabic and English) with full right-to-left support. Ads are painted and reviewed in the language of the chosen dialect.
Reliability: short JSON schemas with one retry, parallel painting, one retry for a passing upstream error, and a per-device limit of 60 requests per 10 minutes at the hosting firewall.
Privacy: the site key stays on the server and never reaches the browser. Ads, brand kits and drafts stay on the device in IndexedDB.
A guided demo that runs the whole site with real Meta models in about two to three and a half minutes.
Checks: 284 unit tests and 267 browser tests, plus a dated entry in BUILD_LOG.md for each change.
planned: Five features shown on the home page as "Coming soon": publishing to Instagram and Facebook, ads on WhatsApp, Reels and Stories video ads, learning from ad results, and an MCP server for AI agents. Their buttons are disabled until they are built.
The final organiser submission. The demo video is published: https://youtu.be/uqqkS3A2vfA
hackathon.metaNote: All three Meta models run live on the production site with the site's own key: Muse Spark 1.3 plans, reads the brand and reviews, SAM 3.1 cuts, and Muse Image 1.0 paints. The fidelity score is Muse Spark's own judgment of the finished ad, and the certificate says so; it is not an independent measure.
hackathon.evidence: Evidence: BUILD_LOG.md and HACKATHON.md in the repository, the GitHub commit and pull-request history, and the Vercel deployments.
hackathon.deadline: Official submission deadline: 4 November 2026, 9:00 PM US Eastern Time (5 November, 4:00 AM Cairo time). The working target is 4 November; check the event page for changes.
